## Home

**Constellation Design** is a creative consultancy driven by curiosity, led by Qa'id Jacobs from Amsterdam.

The studio partners with brands to create meaningful digital experiences rooted in research, storytelling, and craft.

## About

Constellation Design is a creative consultancy led by **Qa'id Jacobs**, a designer and creative director based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

The studio brings a considered, process-led approach to every engagement. Work spans UX design, creative direction, product strategy, and facilitated workshops — often combining multiple disciplines on a single project.

The name Constellation Design reflects how ideas and people connect: individual points of light that, when seen together, form something larger and more meaningful.

---

## Services

### UX Design
Research-grounded interface and experience design. From discovery and mapping through to wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.

### Creative Direction
Visual identity, art direction, and brand expression. Shaping how a brand looks, sounds, and feels across digital and physical touchpoints.

### Product Strategy
Helping teams define what to build and why. Facilitated workshops, opportunity mapping, roadmap planning, and strategic framing.

### Workshops
Tailored working sessions for teams and organisations. Formats include design sprints, discovery workshops, brand definition, and team alignment.

---

## Work

### The Wild
**Category:** Creative Direction
**Client:** The Wild
**Role:** Creative Direction
**Year:** 2024
**Industry:** Publishing & Community

Visual exploration and promotional design for The Wild Pop-up Bookstore.

The Wild is a community pop-up bookstore concept celebrating independent publishing, marginalised voices, and the joy of reading. The project involved developing a visual language that felt alive, community-driven, and rooted in literary culture.

https://constellation.design/work/the-wild

---

### Amplifon's Audiologist Dashboard
**Category:** UX Design
**Client:** Amplifon
**Role:** Design Lead
**Year:** 2023
**Industry:** Healthcare

Optimising the flows and dashboards used by audiologists to assess walk-in patients.

Amplifon is a global leader in hearing care. This project focused on redesigning the internal dashboard used by audiologists during patient consultations — reducing friction, improving information hierarchy, and supporting faster clinical decisions.

https://constellation.design/work/amplifon

---

### The Usual Hotel's User Experience
**Category:** UX Design
**Client:** The Usual Hotel
**Role:** UX Design Lead
**Year:** 2023
**Industry:** Hospitality

Establishing an experience that takes hotel guests from booking online to checking in.

The Usual Hotel is a boutique hotel concept with a focus on simplicity and warmth. This engagement covered the full digital guest journey — from discovery and booking through to on-property digital touchpoints and check-in flows.

https://constellation.design/work/the-usual-hotel

---
